cases.title: Which completed task requested the cancellation lost at pool checkout?
cases.title_zh: 连接池取出连接时丢失的取消，由哪个已结束入口发起？

findings.observation: 240 bounded, database-free queue-component trials reproduce lost cancellation in SQLAlchemy 2.0.55 and 2.1.6 on CPython 3.11.18. Native cancelling() already exposes the defect. A separate application extension creates two cancelling Tasks through different entries, then collects them before observing the targets. Both targets have matching native stacks, creation traces, coroutine origins and allocation traces; these omit the historical cancelling entries.
findings.interpretation: Profile events observe the actual C Task.cancel receiver and a cancelling-counter increment, binding each accepted request to its running actor Task. A weak lifetime registry records actor collection. CoroPerf connects the historical cancel-call sample to that same actor's creation, recovering start_deadline_cancel or start_shutdown_cancel. Two independent batches verify 48 historical issuers across both launch orders: 32 in affected releases and 16 in the fixed release. Cancellation provenance is a separate causal relation, never target creation ancestry.
findings.limits: The component uses real released AsyncAdaptedQueue through greenlet_spawn, without a DBAPI or database. The historical-issuer extension adds an observation gate and is not the literal upstream program. SQLAlchemy 2.0.56 on Python 3.11 and Python 3.12.16 with both older releases pass the component repair controls; 2.1.7 and Python 3.10 or earlier were not tested. Stock and captured application outcomes agree. Removing cancel history or Task creation prevents attribution. All SQLAlchemy and greenlet Python/native files match official hashed PyPI wheels. The native flags already identify cancellation loss; CoroPerf adds historical issuer identity, not root-cause discovery or a new repair. No production overhead result is claimed.

findings_zh.observation: 240 次有界、无需数据库的队列组件对照，在 CPython 3.11.18 的 SQLAlchemy 2.0.55、2.1.6 上复现取消丢失。原生 cancelling() 已能显示缺陷。另设应用扩展：两个取消 Task 从不同入口创建，在事后观察目标前均被回收。两个目标的原生栈、创建栈、协程起源和分配栈相同，均未保留历史取消入口。
findings_zh.interpretation: profile 事件记录实际 C Task.cancel 接收对象与取消计数递增，将每次已接受的请求绑定到当时运行的发起 Task；弱生命周期记录确认其已回收。coroPerf 把历史取消调用采样接回同一发起 Task 的创建，恢复 start_deadline_cancel 或 start_shutdown_cancel。两个独立批次交换两种启动顺序，共核对 48 个历史来源：受影响版本 32 个、修复版 16 个。取消来源单独保存为因果关系，不冒充目标 Task 的创建祖先。
findings_zh.limits: 组件对照通过 greenlet_spawn 调用真实发布版 AsyncAdaptedQueue，不使用 DBAPI 或数据库。历史来源扩展增加了观察 gate，与上游原程序分开。Python 3.11 的 SQLAlchemy 2.0.56，以及 Python 3.12.16 的两个旧版本均通过组件修复对照；未测试 2.1.7 或 Python 3.10 及更早版本。原生与采集模式的应用结果一致。删除取消历史或 Task 创建记录后均无法归属。SQLAlchemy、greenlet 的全部 Python 与原生文件均与通过哈希校验的官方 PyPI wheel 相同。原生标志已可识别取消丢失；coroPerf 补充历史发起者身份，不声称发现根因或提供新修复。未测生产开销。

cases.contribution: Native flags already show cancellation loss. Actual C Task.cancel receivers connect later targets to collected cancelling Tasks; each historical actor sample joins to its own creation entry. The component repair controls and application extension are separate.
cases.contribution_zh: 原生标志已显示取消丢失。实际 C Task.cancel 接收对象把事后目标接回已回收的取消 Task；历史发起者采样只接回自身创建入口。组件修复对照与应用扩展分开。

cases.title: Which completed notification reader acquired the still-held connection lock?
cases.title_zh: 通知生成器仍占用的连接锁，最初由哪个读取入口取得？

findings.observation: The bounded shared-connection control confirms that notification iteration holds the driver connection lock while a query waits. A separate historical-caller extension transfers each paused generator after one identical notification, then lets its reader Task be collected. Both later queries have identical native await stacks; the PostgreSQL backends are idle. Generator frames and allocation traces, current Task creation traces and coroutine origins omit the completed readers' application entries.
findings.interpretation: A profile event records the running Task at each successful acquisition. The returned generator's actual suspended frame identifies the same connection lock. At the later wait, that lock has no intervening release. Joining its acquisition history to Task creation recovers start_report or start_refresh after the acquirer Task is collected. Two independent batches verify 32 historical callers across both driver versions and both read/query launch orders. Resource-wait edges remain separate from creation edges.
findings.limits: The experiment uses Psycopg 3.2.3 and 3.3.9 with the pure Python implementation, CPython 3.12.16, PostgreSQL/libpq 14.13 and private local databases. Four bounded controls check the report's shared-versus-separate-connection mechanism; the literal 2022 program is not executed. The historical-reader extension is separate. Explicitly closing the paused generator releases the lock and returns 42; the 32 closed-generator controls complete without waiting. This is application cleanup, not a claimed driver repair. Removing lock history or Task creation prevents attribution. The displayed joins identify historical acquisition samples, not a live owner Task or a query-creation parent.

findings_zh.observation: 有界的共享连接对照确认：通知迭代持有驱动连接锁时，查询会等待。另设历史调用者扩展：每个生成器产出同一条通知后被移交，原读取 Task 随后被回收。后续两条查询拥有相同的原生 await 栈，PostgreSQL 后端均为空闲。生成器帧与分配栈、当前 Task 的创建栈及协程起源，都缺少已经结束的读取入口。
findings_zh.interpretation: 在成功取锁时记录实际运行的 Task；返回生成器的真实挂起帧指向同一个连接锁。后续查询等待该锁时，中间没有释放事件。沿锁的获取历史接回 Task 创建，即使取锁 Task 已被回收，仍可恢复 start_report 或 start_refresh。两个独立批次覆盖两个驱动版本及两种读取、查询顺序，共验证 32 个历史调用者。资源等待关系与创建关系分别保存。
findings_zh.limits: 实验使用纯 Python 实现的 Psycopg 3.2.3、3.3.9，CPython 3.12.16，以及本地私有数据库上的 PostgreSQL/libpq 14.13。四个有界对照检查报告中的共享连接与独立连接机制，未执行 2022 年的原始程序；历史读取入口扩展另行标明。显式关闭已暂停的生成器后，锁释放且查询返回 42；32 个提前关闭生成器的对照都无需等待。这是应用清理措施，不声称修复了驱动。删除锁历史或 Task 创建记录后均无法归属。展示的拼接连接历史取锁采样，不把已结束的 Task 说成实时持锁者，也不把取锁者说成查询 Task 的创建者。

cases.contribution: Record each historical acquisition under the running reader Task. The same unreleased connection lock and suspended generator frame connect later query waits to the completed reader and its creation. Resource waits remain distinct from Task creation.
cases.contribution_zh: 在读取 Task 运行时记录实际取锁。通过同一未释放的连接锁及生成器挂起帧，把后续查询等待接回已结束的读取 Task 与其创建入口；资源等待关系不冒充 Task 创建关系。

cases.title: Which Spark file-read entry submitted each failing Future?
cases.title_zh: 每个失败的 Spark 文件检查 Future 是由哪个读取入口提交的？

findings.observation: The direct DataSource path-check replay loses the application caller on Spark 3.5.1 and recovers it with the existing helper on 4.1.1. In the asynchronous application extension, both releases report the same missing local file from two otherwise identical worker stacks. The 4.1.1 helper reaches the shared application task but omits both historical launchers. Existing-file controls return the expected single path.
findings.interpretation: Capture the actual FutureTask submitted by each launcher. When the application worker submits a Scala Future, its executing FutureTask is the same recorded object. Match the callable passed to Future.apply to the same live callable in the error stack, and bind it to the returned Future. These two object relationships recover the interactive and batch entries from identical creation and execution stacks. A separate catch observer checks the exact returned Throwable against the original task owner. Across two batches, both launch orders and both releases, all 16 historical callers match.
findings.limits: This is a local-file component replay of the public DataSource API, plus an explicitly separate application-executor extension. It does not run the reporter's private HDFS job. The ordinary exception and selected JFR exception/thread-ancestry controls omit the historical entry in the extension. Stock 4.1.1 already solves the direct-call endpoint. Removing the Future binding, historical creation or parent-task relation prevents recovery of the original entry. Missing-path errors remain expected input failures; CoroPerf restores their caller context.

findings_zh.observation: 直接调用 DataSource 文件检查时，Spark 3.5.1 的异常栈丢失应用调用者，4.1.1 的现有辅助方法可恢复它。在另加的应用异步执行器场景里，两版均在相同工作栈报告同一个本地缺失文件。4.1.1 的辅助方法能接回共享应用任务，但仍省略两个历史入口。文件存在的对照均返回预期的一条路径。
findings_zh.interpretation: 先记录各入口提交的实际 FutureTask。应用工作线程提交 Scala Future 时，其正在执行的 FutureTask 与先前记录为同一对象。再把交给 Future.apply 的函数对象，与错误栈中仍在执行的同一个函数对象及其返回 Future 关联。两层对象关系将相同的创建栈、执行栈接回交互和批处理入口。独立的 catch 观测用实际 Throwable 核对源任务归属。两组重复、两种启动顺序和两个发布版本共 16 个历史调用者全部匹配。
findings_zh.limits: 这是公开 DataSource API 的本地文件组件复现，另含明确区分的应用执行器扩展；未运行报告者的私有 HDFS 作业。扩展中，普通异常栈及所测 JFR 异常和线程祖先记录都缺少历史入口。4.1.1 的原生能力已经解决直接调用的原始端点。去掉 Future 绑定、历史创建或父任务关系后，均无法恢复原始入口。缺失路径仍会按预期报错，coroPerf 补全其调用上下文。

cases.contribution: Join the failing Scala Future through its exact submitted callable and the executing application FutureTask. The parent task creation restores two historical file-read entries from identical dispatch and worker stacks.
cases.contribution_zh: 用同一个提交函数对象识别失败的 Scala Future，再通过实际正在执行的应用 FutureTask 接回父任务创建记录，从相同分派栈和工作栈恢复两个历史文件读取入口。

cases.title: Which LangChain4j retry caller is still waiting after exception mapping fails?
cases.title_zh: LangChain4j 的异常映射器抛错后，哪些重试调用仍在等待？

findings.observation: Two custom exception mappers throw on a worker. On main, both caller Futures remain pending after the worker finishes. The mapper failures are visible in the dependent stages returned by whenComplete. With PR #7070 applied, each caller Future completes exceptionally with its own mapper's exact throwable after just one attempt. The already-failed input case gives the same before-and-after result.
findings.interpretation: The two mapper executions have identical physical stacks. The completion callback carries the exact caller Future previously observed at the first attempt. Matching JDI object IDs joins record 2 to the batch launch in record 1, and record 3 to the interactive launch in record 0. Reversing completion order swaps the recovered callers.
findings.limits: The Java 17 fixture supplies both failed attempts and explicitly throwing custom mappers. The traced retry sources are from main 8705b925d715 and the same revision with the production change from open PR #7070. All 24 tests from the PR pass with that change. Four mapper-failure tests fail on main. The issue remains open.

findings_zh.observation: 两个自定义异常映射器在工作线程抛错。主分支上，工作线程结束后两个调用方 Future 仍处于等待状态，映射失败则出现在 whenComplete 返回的下游阶段。应用 PR #7070 后，每个调用方 Future 都以对应映射器抛出的同一个异常对象结束，且仅尝试一次。输入 Future 在调用前就已失败的对照结果相同。
findings_zh.interpretation: 两次映射回调的物理执行栈完全相同。回调携带的 Future 与首次尝试时观测到的调用方 Future 是同一个对象。按 JDI 对象 ID 将记录 2 接回记录 1 的批处理入口，将记录 3 接回记录 0 的交互入口。交换完成顺序后，恢复出的调用者也随之交换。
findings_zh.limits: Java 17 夹具提供两条失败请求及显式抛错的自定义映射器。对照使用主分支 8705b925d715 的重试源码和应用开放 PR #7070 生产代码后的同一版本。PR 的 24 项测试全部通过，主分支的 4 项映射失败测试均未通过。Issue 仍开放。

cases.contribution: Match each exception-mapper callback's captured CompletableFuture to the Future from its first retry attempt. Identical execution stacks then reveal which caller is left pending.
cases.contribution_zh: 把异常映射回调捕获的 CompletableFuture 接回首次尝试时的同一个 Future。这样，两条相同的执行栈也能定位各自仍在等待的调用者。

cases.title: Which realtime session pays to rebuild its audio history?
cases.title_zh: 哪条实时转录会话在反复重建历史音频特征？

findings.observation: In one scheduler pass, the 64-chunk session copies 63 already covered audio features and the 4-chunk session copies three. The request-owned prefix patch reduces this to one copy for each session. Both sessions produce the same 64 and four output deltas in both test orders. With an initial history of 1,024 features, median CPU time for one NewRequestData.from_request call is 1.36–1.38 ms on main and 6.66–6.82 µs with the patch, measured with collection off.
findings.interpretation: Records 4 and 5 have identical execution stacks in the same Scheduler.schedule call. The NewRequestData.from_request frame holds the exact persistent Request captured when the scheduler first accepted it. The submitting live asyncio.Task matches the coroutine created by RealtimeConnection.start_generation. This joins 4 → 3 → 1 to captioning and 5 → 2 → 0 to live notes. Swapping which launcher runs the long session swaps the associated copy counts.
findings.limits: This CPU fixture runs the real vLLM generation Task, streaming scheduler, and request conversion with in-process delivery, synthetic features, and supplied model output. Timing covers conversion only. The worker still receives a full feature list per step. Issue #58324 and PR #58334 are open. The PR applied to main 31814a6f6f2d raises AttributeError on the slotted feature class. The tested local adaptation stores the covered prefix on the resumable Request.

findings_zh.observation: 在同一轮调度里，64 个音频片段的会话重复复制 63 个已处理特征，4 个片段的会话复制 3 个。请求级前缀缓存让每个会话只复制 1 个。两种顺序下，两个会话均保持原有的 64 条和 4 条输出增量。历史从 1024 个特征开始时，关闭采集后单次 NewRequestData.from_request 的 CPU 时间中位数从 1.36–1.38 毫秒降到 6.66–6.82 微秒。
findings_zh.interpretation: 记录 4 和 5 来自同一次 Scheduler.schedule，执行栈完全相同。NewRequestData.from_request 中的 Request 与首次进入调度器时是同一个对象。首次提交的活跃 asyncio.Task 与 RealtimeConnection.start_generation 创建的 Task 及其协程一致。4 → 3 → 1 接回实时字幕，5 → 2 → 0 接回实时笔记。交换长短会话的发起入口后，复制次数随对应会话交换。
findings_zh.limits: CPU 实验运行真实的 vLLM 生成 Task、流式调度器和请求转换，通过进程内队列提供合成音频特征与预设模型输出。计时只覆盖请求转换，每步仍向 worker 提供完整特征列表。Issue #58324 和 PR #58334 均开放。PR 应用到主分支 31814a6f6f2d 后，写入带 slots 的特征对象时引发 AttributeError。已验证的本地适配把前缀缓存保存在可续传的 Request 上。

cases.contribution: Match each scheduler snapshot to the exact persistent Request and to the generation Task that first submitted it. The two otherwise identical stacks expose separate callers and account for 63 and three redundant feature copies.
cases.contribution_zh: 用持续存在的同一个 Request 将调度观测接回首次提交的生成 Task。两条相同的执行栈接回不同入口，并分别对应 63 次和 3 次历史特征复制。

cases.title: Which TEI request pays for padding in a mixed-length batch?
cases.title_zh: TEI 长短输入混合成批时，哪些请求承担了填充开销？

findings.observation: A 32-request backlog alternates 160-token catalog inputs with 16-token search inputs. FIFO uses 5,120 padded token positions. Sorting fixed windows of 16 uses 2,816 across the same eight batches of four. On the CPU Candle fixture, median backlog drain time over eight trials per arm is 1,234.4 ms for FIFO and 719.8 ms for sorting. The first catalog request finishes later, at median 200.6 versus 237.7 ms. The largest absolute embedding difference is below 5.37e-7.
findings.interpretation: Records 1 and 3 have the same physical embedding-resume stack on one Tokio worker. Each running Task matches the JoinHandle captured at its own launch, and the request metadata carries that Task ID to backend dispatch. This joins record 1 to catalog ingestion and record 3 to interactive search. In the FIFO capture these two requests share a batch padded to 160 tokens per input. The sorted capture groups the search request with other 16-token inputs.
findings.limits: A fixture holds the batching task until all 32 requests arrive. Stack collection is off during timing. The loopback HTTP check validates embeddings and the opt-in on the real router. The performance comparison covers this CPU model and controlled backlog. The patch keeps FIFO as the default and only sorts complete windows for padded backends. The issue remains open.

findings_zh.observation: 积压队列有 32 条交替输入，索引请求各 160 token，搜索请求各 16 token。FIFO 共需计算 5120 个填充后位置。按固定的 16 条窗口排序后，仍为 8 批、每批 4 条，位置数降至 2816。Candle CPU 实验每组运行 8 次，处理完积压的耗时中位数从 1234.4 降至 719.8 毫秒。第一条索引请求完成得更晚，中位数从 200.6 增至 237.7 毫秒。向量最大绝对差小于 5.37e-7。
findings_zh.interpretation: 记录 1 和 3 在同一个 Tokio worker 上恢复向量请求，物理栈完全相同。用实际 Task ID 接回各自发起时的 JoinHandle，再用进入后端批次的请求元数据核对同一个 ID。记录 1 接回索引入口，记录 3 接回搜索入口。FIFO 时两条请求同批，每条填充至 160 token。排序后这条搜索请求与其他 16-token 输入同批。
findings_zh.limits: 实验等 32 条请求全部入队后才放行批处理 Task，计时时关闭栈采集。真实路由器的本机 HTTP 对照核对返回向量及配置是否可用。性能数字适用于这个 CPU 模型与积压形态。补丁默认使用 FIFO，只对需要填充的后端按完整窗口排序。Issue 仍开放。

cases.title: Which completed verl rollouts are still counted after a reset?
cases.title_zh: verl 重置计数后，哪些已完成的 rollout 仍被计入？

findings.observation: The reported revision, released verl v0.9.1 and the migrated recipe at 654568c reproduce the same ordering bug. Seventy rollouts publish, the consumer removes 64, and six remain queued. Resetting before the finished Tasks are reaped stores 76. At a limit of 70 the processor admits no new rollouts, even after reaping. The reporter's patch applied to the release and recipe stores 6 in both event orders and delivers the next batch of 64. It passes all 14 CPU controls on both versions.
findings.interpretation: Two identical queue publication stacks join to distinct sample Tasks created by the same processor. The exact payload from record 2 was already consumed when reset counted its finished Task. The payload from record 4 was still queued and its finished Task was also counted. Record 5 joins the admission pause at 76 to the same processor creation at record 0.
findings.limits: The replay runs repository dispatch, publish, queue, and reset methods on a single event loop. Local events control the ordering and stand in for model completion. The issue is closed as not planned. The local patch covers the legacy recipe. The replacement V1 trainer is outside the experiment.

findings_zh.observation: 报告版本、verl v0.9.1 发布版和迁移后的 recipe 654568c 均复现了相同的时序问题。70 个 rollout 发布结果，训练侧取走 64 个，队列中剩 6 个。若先重置计数、再移除已完成的 Task，计数变成 76。上限为 70 时，处理器随后即使移除了这些 Task 也无法接纳新样本。报告者的补丁应用到发布版和 recipe 后，两种事件顺序均重置为 6，下一批均凑齐 64 条。两个版本都通过 14 项 CPU 检查。
findings_zh.interpretation: 两条完全相同的队列发布栈分别接回两个样本 Task，它们均由同一个处理 Task 创建。记录 2 的结果在重置前已被消费，已完成的 Task 仍被计入。记录 4 的结果仍在队列，已完成的 Task 也被计入。记录 5 将计数为 76 时的接纳暂停接回同一个处理 Task 的创建记录 0。
findings_zh.limits: 实验在单个事件循环中运行仓库中的派发、发布、队列和重置逻辑，用本地事件控制顺序并代表模型完成。Issue 已关闭，GitHub 标记为不计划处理。本地补丁覆盖旧版 recipe，替代它的 V1 训练器不在本次实验范围内。

cases.contribution: The two matching publication stacks belong to separate sample Tasks. Object identity separates the sample already taken by the consumer from one still queued. Both Tasks remain counted, and the same processor pauses at 76 instead of dispatching the next batch.
cases.contribution_zh: 两条相同的发布栈属于不同的样本 Task。按对象身份核对，一个结果已被训练端取走，另一个仍在队列。两个已完成 Task 都被计入，同一个处理器在计数为 76 时暂停接纳。

cases.title: Which failed callbacks belong to the missing vLLM probe count?
cases.title_zh: vLLM 性能基准漏报了哪些失败的探针？

findings.observation: The reported revision and checked main run two probes that both return HTTP 503. Each run also completes one workload request and records one workload failure. The console and saved JSON omit both probe counters. Open PR #69262 and the same patch applied to main report 0 completed probes and 2 failed probes. Probe latency fields remain absent when every probe fails. The mixed, success-only, and disabled-probe controls preserve the expected reports.
findings.interpretation: All three failed responses reach the same aiohttp receive stack outside an active Task. The live ResponseHandler links each callback to its send. The sending asyncio Task links observations 1 and 2 to one probe creation at record 0, and observation 4 to the workload creation at record 3. The returned RequestFuncOutput objects are the same objects in the benchmark's two result lists, so the missing counters can be attributed to the two verified probe failures.
findings.limits: The original benchmark parser, scheduler, HTTP client, console summary and JSON writer run against fixed responses on a loopback endpoint. This verifies reporting and ownership in the benchmark client. Model inference and serving throughput are unmeasured. The issue and PR remain open.

findings_zh.observation: 报告版本和所核对的主分支均发送两次探针，两次都收到 HTTP 503。每次运行的主负载均成功一次、失败一次。终端和 JSON 都漏掉两个探针计数。开放的 PR #69262 以及应用同一补丁的主分支均报告探针成功 0 次、失败 2 次。探针全部失败时仍不输出延迟统计。部分探针失败、全部成功和关闭探针的对照仍按预期报告。
findings_zh.interpretation: 三次失败响应都进入完全相同的 aiohttp 接收栈，回调时没有正在运行的 Task。通过同一个实际 ResponseHandler 接回各次发送，再用实际 asyncio Task 把记录 1、2 接回同一个探针创建记录 0，把记录 4 接回主负载的创建记录 3。函数返回的 RequestFuncOutput 就是基准程序两个结果列表中的对象，由此确认漏计的是这两次探针失败。
findings_zh.limits: 实验运行原始的基准参数解析、任务调度、HTTP 客户端、终端摘要和 JSON 写入，响应由本机回环服务固定提供。结论覆盖基准客户端的报告和任务归属。模型生成与真实推理吞吐量未测量。Issue 和 PR 均仍开放。

cases.contribution: Match identical HTTP failure callbacks to live senders and the exact result objects delivered to reporting. Two failures belong to the probe Task and disappear from the original report. The third belongs to a workload Task and is already counted.
cases.contribution_zh: 将相同的 HTTP 失败回调接回实际发送的 Task，再核对进入报告的结果对象。两次失败属于探针 Task，原报告漏掉了这两次。第三次属于主负载 Task，原报告已计入。

cases.title: Which Ray generator keeps waking a backpressured data executor?
cases.title_zh: 读取预算为零时，哪个 Ray 生成器让数据执行器反复调度？

findings.observation: With open PR #67572 applied to Ray 2.59.0, the median 600 ms consumer pause goes from 1,054 to 135 scheduling steps and from 600 to 279 ms of executor thread CPU. On master at 01ef5c0, the local adaptation goes from 964.5 to 5 steps and from 597.8 to 10.5 ms of executor thread CPU. Each version has 12 runs per arm. Every run delivers the same 131,072 ordered rows.
findings.interpretation: Driver records 2 and 7 have identical polling stacks and each reads zero bytes. A live ObjectRefGenerator matches the ready result from ray.wait to the driver creation. The Ray native task ID and TaskContext index also match that creation to the actor's own asyncio.Task. Actor resume records 4 and 9 connect to those exact Tasks, then to the distinct training and validation launches.
findings.limits: The public iter_batches fixture uses in-memory data on one local CPU node. The 2.59.0 arm uses the PR's exact scheduler changes. The master adaptation preserves the newer output lock and resource accounting. Seven upstream regression tests pass on the adapted build. The displayed stacks come from a separate trace of unpatched master at 01ef5c0. The issue and upstream PR remain open.

findings_zh.observation: 消费者暂停约 600 毫秒时，Ray 2.59.0 应用开放的 PR #67572 后，调度次数中位数从 1054 降至 135，执行器线程 CPU 时间从 600 降至 279 毫秒。主分支 01ef5c0 应用本地适配版后，两项中位数分别从 964.5 降至 5、从 597.8 降至 10.5 毫秒。每个版本的原版和补丁版各运行 12 次，每次按序交付相同的 131072 行。
findings_zh.interpretation: 驱动端记录 2 和 7 的轮询栈完全相同，实际读取均为零。用同一个 ObjectRefGenerator 把 ray.wait 返回的就绪对象接回驱动端创建记录。Ray 原生任务 ID 和 TaskContext 编号又把这份记录接到 actor 中实际创建的 asyncio.Task。actor 恢复记录 4、9 分别接回该 Task，并继续回溯到训练和验证数据集各自的发起位置。
findings_zh.limits: 实验通过单节点、纯 CPU 的公开 iter_batches 接口运行，使用内存数据。2.59.0 实验沿用 PR 原始调度改动，主分支适配版保留新版输出锁和资源计数，并通过 7 项上游回归测试。页面展示的栈来自未打补丁的主分支 01ef5c0 的独立跟踪实验。Issue 和上游 PR 均仍开放。

cases.contribution: Match the zero-byte read of the ready generator to its registration. The native Ray task ID reaches the actor asyncio.Task, and the operator identity reaches the original training or validation iterator.
cases.contribution_zh: 把已就绪却读取零字节的生成器接回登记位置。Ray 原生任务 ID 将它接到 actor 的 asyncio.Task，算子身份将它接回训练或验证迭代器的发起位置。

cases.title: Which conversations did the vLLM benchmark leave unfinished?
cases.title_zh: vLLM 多轮基准退出时留下了哪些未完成的对话？

findings.observation: The v0.29.0 CLI and checked main send three of four requests with one client and two active conversations. Two clients with four three-turn conversations send ten of twelve. Both runs exit with code zero. The loopback POSTs and the exported statistics agree on every conversation and turn. PR #57181 restores all expected turns and preserves the deliberate two-request limit.
findings.interpretation: The two response callbacks have identical physical frames, as do the two client exit stacks. Records 2 and 6 attach to the exact sending Tasks through their aiohttp ResponseHandler objects. Records 3 and 7 are those same Tasks at exit. The child PIDs and client indices link their creation records 1 and 5 to the driver launches 0 and 4. The original queue and conversation objects identify one pending third user request at each exit, after the input sentinel and with zero failed requests.
findings.limits: The experiment runs the entire benchmark CLI, multiprocessing queues, aiohttp client and statistics export on Linux with a local tokenizer and fixed loopback SSE. The traced workers use Python's spawn start method, and the driver's frames are absent from the raw child stacks. Model inference and throughput are unmeasured. The issue and PR #57181 remain open. The separate queue-collection PR #69282 still sends three of four in the minimal case by itself.

findings_zh.observation: v0.29.0 和所核对的主分支在单客户端、两个活跃对话下应发 4 次，实际发出 3 次。双客户端处理四个三轮对话时，应发 12 次，实际发出 10 次。进程都以状态码 0 退出。本机收到的每一个对话和轮次都与导出的统计一致。PR #57181 补齐了应发的轮次，并保留显式设置的 2 次请求上限。
findings_zh.interpretation: 两个客户端的响应回调栈完全相同，退出栈也完全相同。用 aiohttp 的实际 ResponseHandler 把接收记录 2、6 接回发送 Task。退出记录 3、7 来自这两个 Task 本身。再用子进程 PID 和客户端编号，将 Task 创建记录 1、5 接回主进程启动记录 0、4。真实队列和本地对话对象显示，两边都在取到队列结束标记后退出，各留下一次未发的第三轮用户请求，请求失败数为零。
findings_zh.limits: 实验在 Linux 本机运行完整基准 CLI、进程间队列、aiohttp 客户端和统计导出，并使用本地分词器及固定 SSE 响应。跟踪使用 Python 的 spawn 方式，子进程原始栈不含主进程的发起帧。未测真实模型的推理吞吐。Issue 和 PR #57181 仍开放。单独应用处理结果队列的 PR #69282 时，最小场景仍只发出 3 次。

cases.contribution: Identical receive and exit stacks join to two separate client Tasks and their launches in the parent process. Matching each admitted conversation to its socket and final Task state shows two requests were never sent.
cases.contribution_zh: 把相同的接收栈和退出栈分别接回两个客户端 Task 及其主进程启动位置。用同一个对话对象核对实际接收和退出状态，确认有两轮请求从未发出。

cases.title: Which Polars scan keeps running after the merge-join limit?
cases.title_zh: Polars 的流式连接达到行数上限后，哪个扫描任务还在读取？

findings.observation: Both official releases produce the expected 50 ordered rows. At 16 threads, Polars 2.1.0 reads median 36,000 feature rows and 37,000 label rows across 15 runs. A direct limit pushes down 50 rows to the source. A one-thread control reads 5,000 and 6,000 rows and preserves the results. Across both traced runs, the right input generates 9 to 10 more batches between the first stop writes to the left and right inputs.
findings.interpretation: The two bridge callbacks have identical native address stacks. Matching each Task's Arc at first scheduling and execution recovers two separate bridge instances. The same SourceToken links the slice write in record 1 to the merge planner check in record 3. The planner drains its left input before signaling the right. Its writes in records 4 and 5 match the bridge checks in records 7 and 9, respectively. This distinguishes the left bridge that already saw the stop from the right bridge that could still deliver batches.
findings.limits: A local parallel-drain patch passes 96 correctness controls and the upstream early-close test. Across 100 interleaved runs per variant and arm at 16 threads, median total input rows move from 74,000 to 73,000 on aligned keys and from 60,000 to 59,000 on offset keys. Both ranges still overlap. The issue is open and excess reads persist. The stripped stacks retain offsets from the official wheel. The byte-identical text section of the original supplies the labels.

findings_zh.observation: 两个官方版本都正确返回有序的 50 行。Polars 2.1.0 使用 16 个线程重复运行 15 次，左右输入读取量的中位数分别为 36000 和 37000 行。直接在单个源上取 50 行时，上限能下推到数据源。用单线程对照时，连接结果一致，左右读取量的中位数降至 5000 和 6000 行。两次原生跟踪中，右侧数据源在左、右输入先后收到停止信号之间仍生成了 9 到 10 批。
findings_zh.interpretation: 两个扫描桥任务的原生地址栈完全相同。匹配 Task 首次调度时和执行时的 Arc，能接回各自的创建记录。同一个 SourceToken 把截断任务在记录 1 写入的停止信号接到连接任务在记录 3 的检查。连接任务先排空左侧输入，再通知右侧。记录 4 和 5 的输入信号分别对应两个扫描桥在记录 7 和 9 的检查，由此确定哪个已经看到停止信号、哪个仍在交付数据。
findings_zh.limits: 本地并行排空补丁通过 96 组结果对照和上游的提前结束测试。16 线程下每种输入、每个构建各交错运行 100 次，输入总量的中位数在键对齐时从 74000 降至 73000 行，键错开时从 60000 降至 59000 行。两组读数区间仍重叠，额外读取依然存在，issue 仍开放。剥离符号的栈保留官方发行版的指令偏移，函数名由代码段字节一致的原版补充。

cases.contribution: Match the exact native Tasks to their launches and follow each SourceToken from its write to its check. Identical stripped bridge stacks belong to separate input tasks. The left scan sees the stop while the right scan continues to deliver rows.
cases.contribution_zh: 用实际原生 Task 接回创建栈，并通过同一个 SourceToken 追踪每次停止信号的写入和读取。剥离符号后，两条完全相同的扫描桥执行栈分别属于左右输入。左侧收到停止信号时，右侧仍在交付数据。

cases.title: Which vLLM benchmark Task sent the 64-token probe?
cases.title_zh: 哪个 vLLM 基准 Task 发出了上限为 64 token 的探针请求？

findings.observation: Completions, Chat Completions and Responses all send a 64-token limit from both the probe and workload on the reported version and the checked main revision. With a per-request override of 17, both send 17. PR #66260, both at its head and applied to the checked main revision, sends probe limit 1 in both controls, keeps the main workload at 64 or 17, and preserves the temperature setting. Across all four revisions, 48 benchmark runs complete successfully.
findings.interpretation: The two Chat Completions POST bodies and their socket receive stacks are identical on main. In ClientRequest.send, CoroPerf records the live ResponseHandler and its sending asyncio Task. The callback in record 1 uses that same handler and joins to the probe Task creation in record 0. Record 3 joins to the workload Task creation in record 2 by the same relationship. This identifies a 64-token limit on the one-token probe path even when the wire body supplies no role marker.
findings.limits: The fixture runs benchmark() with the original scheduling and HTTP clients. A loopback stub sends a fixed one-token stream, so the result establishes requested token limits and request ownership. Generation times on a model and end-to-end serving throughput are unmeasured. The GitHub issue and proposed fix remain open.

findings_zh.observation: Completion、Chat Completion 和 Responses 三个后端都复现了问题。报告版本和所核对的主分支上，探针与主负载均发出 64 token 的上限。单条请求覆盖为 17 时，两者均发出 17。分别在 PR #66260 的提交和已应用该 PR 的主分支上验证后，探针两种情况下均发出 1，主负载保持 64 或 17，temperature 也保留。四个版本共完成 48 次基准运行。
findings_zh.interpretation: 主分支上的两条 Chat Completion 请求，POST 请求体和响应接收栈完全相同。CoroPerf 在 ClientRequest.send 记录实际的 ResponseHandler 和发出请求的 asyncio Task。观测记录 1 通过该对象接回探针 Task 的创建记录 0，观测记录 3 通过同一关系接回主负载 Task 的创建记录 2。由此确认本应只请求 1 token 的探针发出了 64 token 的上限，即使请求体没有区分角色的标记。
findings_zh.limits: 实验运行 benchmark() 的原有调度和 HTTP 客户端。本机回环服务固定返回一个 token，用来核对实际请求的上限及所属任务。模型生成耗时和端到端推理吞吐量未测量。GitHub issue 与修复 PR 均仍开放。

cases.contribution: Two identical response stacks and request bodies join to separate probe and workload Task creations. The exact aiohttp protocol and sending Task identify which 64-token POST belongs to the one-token probe.
cases.contribution_zh: 两条响应接收栈和请求体完全相同，却分别接回探针和主负载 Task 的创建位置。通过同一个 aiohttp 协议对象与发送 Task，可确认哪条上限为 64 token 的请求来自本应只请求 1 token 的探针。

cases.title: Which TensorRT-LLM HTTP batch paid for each repeated count?
cases.title_zh: TensorRT-LLM 哪次 HTTP 批次提交承担了重复计数？

findings.observation: For 1,024 items, the original store makes 1,025 passes and visits 525,824 historical rows, including the final recount. PR #22280 records 1,024 individual outcomes without those scans. Event-loop thread CPU from loopback submission to batch completion drops from 235–256 ms to 20.4–21.3 ms in the two run orders. Both runs return the same 930 successes and 94 synthetic item errors. The proposal publishes the results URL only after the batch ends.
findings.interpretation: The two worker samples have identical _recount execution stacks after their HTTP submitters have finished. The executing asyncio Task and exact batch record connect observation 8 to worker creation 1, and the active parent batch Task connects it to HTTP creation 0 for evaluation. The indexing path is 9 → 4 → 3. Both paths remain correct when the POST order is reversed. In the traced base, the two-item evaluation batch visits five historical rows and the four-item indexing batch visits fourteen.
findings.limits: The experiment runs the pinned TensorRT-LLM batch store, protocol models and route methods over a real loopback HTTP server with a synthetic item runner. Timings use seven warmed trials per size and arm in each order, with stack collection disabled. The 1,024-item pass counts come from a separate instrumented run. Cancellation keeps the same final results. The proposal passes all 30 upstream tests. Two new assertions fail on the base. GPU inference is outside scope. The current main batch store matches the PR base file, and the tracker and PR are open.

findings_zh.observation: 处理 1024 条时，原版计数 1025 次，共访问 525824 条历史结果，包含结束时的最后一次重计。PR #22280 对 1024 条结果逐条更新计数，省去历史扫描。两种测试顺序中，从环回 HTTP 提交到批次结束的事件循环线程 CPU 中位数由 235–256 毫秒降至 20.4–21.3 毫秒。两版返回相同的 930 个成功结果和 94 个模拟单条失败。候选补丁在批次结束后才公布结果 URL。
findings_zh.interpretation: 两个 HTTP 提交已返回，两条 worker 的 _recount 执行栈仍相同。通过实际运行的 asyncio Task 和同一个批次对象，把执行记录 8 接回 worker 创建记录 1，再用当时活跃的父批次 Task 接回评估请求的 HTTP 创建记录 0。索引请求的路径是 9 → 4 → 3。反转 POST 顺序后两条路径仍正确。原版追踪中，两条的评估批次访问历史结果五次，四条的索引批次访问十四次。
findings_zh.limits: 实验使用固定版本的批次存储、协议模型和路由方法，通过真实环回 HTTP 调用，单条推理由测试替身返回。每种规模、版本和运行顺序各测 7 次，计时轮关闭栈采集。1024 条时的遍历次数另行记录。取消操作的最终结果一致。候选版通过 30 项上游测试，其中两项新增断言在原版上失败。GPU 推理超出本次测量范围。核对时主分支的批次存储文件与 PR 基线相同，Issue 和 PR 均开放。

cases.contribution: Identical recount stacks join through live worker Tasks to the batch Tasks created by two HTTP submissions. The shared batch record assigns each repeated scan to the right evaluation or indexing batch.
cases.contribution_zh: 通过实际 worker Task，把相同的重复计数栈接回两次 HTTP 提交所创建的批次 Task。用同一个批次对象确认每次重复扫描属于评估批次还是索引批次。

cases.title: Which Ollama embedding batch paid for the frontend vocabulary load?
cases.title_zh: Ollama 哪一批 embedding 请求承担了前端词表加载？

findings.observation: With all-minilm already loaded in the CPU runner, the first 12-text request takes a median 134.3 ms after runner acquisition on the historical base and 100.1 ms with the local adaptation of PR #7424. Warm medians are 101.0 and 96.8 ms. The first vocabulary load costs 26.8–27.5 ms in the two traced orders. All embedding coordinates match exactly. The proposal counts two extra special tokens per text.
findings.interpretation: The catalog and query workers have identical Embedding stacks. The exact Go context ticket carries the initiating HTTP request and input row into the errgroup worker. Its payload fingerprint agrees with the preflight tokenization and the separate runner's JSON input. Execution record 1 joins to the catalog worker's creation 0. Execution record 3 joins to the query worker's creation 2. The first request's host vocabulary load and per-row tokenizations finish before it creates its workers. Reversing the requests moves the vocabulary cost from the twelve-row catalog batch to the one-row query.
findings.limits: The replay uses real loopback /api/embed and the historical CPU runner with ordinary in-context text. An empty request primes the runner before each comparison. Each cold median uses five fresh processes per arm and task order. The warm medians pool 35 requests per shape and arm. The proposal adaptation removes the shared counter update by storing counts per row. This isolates historical endpoint overhead. The candidate changes reported token counts and the original Sentence Transformers comparison is outside the experiment. Issue #7400 is open and PR #7424 closed without merging.

findings_zh.observation: CPU runner 已加载 all-minilm 时，历史原版第一个 12 条文本请求在拿到 runner 后的耗时中位数为 134.3 毫秒，采用 PR #7424 的本地改版后为 100.1 毫秒。预热后的中位数为 101.0 和 96.8 毫秒。两种发起顺序中，首次加载前端词表耗时 26.8–27.5 毫秒。所有向量分量完全一致，候选版本每条文本多统计两个特殊 token。
findings_zh.interpretation: 批量目录请求和单条查询的 worker 具有相同的 Embedding 执行栈。实际 Go context 携带的同一个记录对象将 HTTP 请求及输入行传给 errgroup worker，文本指纹与前端分词记录及另一进程收到的 JSON 输入一致。执行记录 1 接回批量目录请求的创建记录 0，执行记录 3 接回单条查询的创建记录 2。首个请求在创建 worker 前完成前端词表加载及逐条分词。交换请求顺序后，加载开销归到单条查询。
findings_zh.limits: 使用真实的环回 /api/embed、历史 CPU runner 和上下文长度以内的普通文本。每次对照先用空请求加载 runner。每组首请求中位数来自 5 个独立进程，每种请求的预热中位数来自每版 35 次请求。候选改版按输入行分别写入计数。测试覆盖历史端点开销，候选版改变了 token 统计口径，原报告与 Sentence Transformers 的对比超出本次测量范围。Issue #7400 仍开放，PR #7424 关闭时未合并。

cases.contribution: Identical embedding stacks join to separate HTTP requests through the original request and row carried by the worker's Go context. The joins distinguish the first caller that paid for vocabulary loading from the next request's warm preflight.
cases.contribution_zh: 通过 worker 的 Go context 携带的原始 HTTP 请求和输入行，把相同的 embedding 执行栈接回各自的请求，区分先承担词表加载的请求与随后仅做预热后分词的请求。

cases.title: Which Dynamo request occupies the Tokio worker during JSON serialization?
cases.title_zh: Dynamo 哪个请求在 JSON 序列化时占用了 Tokio worker？

findings.observation: For a 60,000-token request on a Tokio multi-thread runtime configured with one worker, the median time from notifying an unrelated ready Task to its first poll is 541–550 µs on the base and 3.33–3.45 µs with PR #9487's isolated block_in_place change. It runs before serialization completes in 0 of 300 base requests and 300 of 300 proposal requests. The JSON bytes and returned token counts match. For the same long requests the local completion time is 1.74–1.77 ms on the base and 1.79–1.85 ms with the change.
findings.interpretation: Both baseline observations have the same executable-address stack in an optimized ELF with the static symbol table and debug sections removed. The stripped instruction at ELF+0x1d54ac calls ELF+0x1c9ec0. The instruction at ELF+0x1c9f41 calls ELF+0x1c6710. Those destinations match the adjacent unwound frames. The address-only stacks are joined to two different launchers by matching the running Tokio Task ID to its original JoinHandle. The JSON body, control envelope and header agree on each request ID, including when the launch order and prompt sizes are swapped. Function labels come from the byte-identical code in the retained symbolized build.
findings.limits: The replay isolates JSON serialization in the pinned AddressedPushRouter, with a local request receiver and a real loopback TCP response stream. Timing runs disable stack collection. The current-thread control retains inline execution and the ready Task runs later in both arms. The experiment measures local scheduling and leaves the reported multi-replica throughput outside scope. The issue is open and PR #9487 closed without merging. The inspected main has a later codec-aware envelope builder which still encodes the JSON fallback inline.

findings_zh.observation: 在配置 1 个 worker 的 Tokio 多线程 runtime 上，60,000-token 请求开始序列化时唤醒另一条 Task。从通知到首次执行的中位数，原版为 541–550 微秒，采用 PR #9487 中单独的 block_in_place 改动后为 3.33–3.45 微秒。序列化结束前就得到执行的比例从 0/300 变为 300/300。两版 JSON 字节和返回的 token 数量一致。同批长请求自身的本地完成时间由 1.74–1.77 毫秒变为 1.79–1.85 毫秒。
findings_zh.interpretation: 去除静态符号表和调试段后，优化 ELF 中的两条原生地址栈完全相同。ELF+0x1d54ac 的指令调用 ELF+0x1c9ec0，ELF+0x1c9f41 的指令调用 ELF+0x1c6710。这两个目标与相邻的回溯帧一致。将执行时的 Tokio Task ID 与发起时的 JoinHandle ID 核对后，两条栈分别接回交互与批处理入口。交换发起顺序和请求长度后，请求 ID 仍在 JSON 正文、控制信封和请求头中一致。函数名来自机器码逐字节相同的带符号副本。
findings_zh.limits: 实验隔离了固定版本 AddressedPushRouter 的 JSON 序列化，使用本地请求接收器和真实的环回 TCP 响应流。计时轮关闭栈记录。Tokio 单线程 runtime 的两组对照均保留内联序列化，就绪任务均在序列化结束后才执行。测量范围为本地调度，原报告的多副本吞吐量超出范围。Issue 仍开放，PR #9487 关闭时未合并。已核对的主分支使用更新的编解码路径，其中 JSON 回退仍在原执行路径上编码。

cases.contribution: The stripped native address stacks match. Tokio Task and request identities recover the launchers and identify which large JSON serialization prevents another ready task from running on the occupied worker.
cases.contribution_zh: 两条剥离符号的原生地址栈一致。Tokio Task 与请求身份恢复各自的发起入口，并确定哪次大型 JSON 序列化占用了 worker，使另一条已就绪任务无法运行。

cases.title: Which SGLang stream pays to merge its queued output metadata?
cases.title_zh: SGLang 哪条流承担了积压输出元数据的合并开销？

findings.observation: The reported revision and pinned main use the same two-part metadata loop. For 32 chunks with two metadata fields first appearing in the final quarter, median thread CPU per coalescing call falls from 17.0–17.8 µs to 9.18–9.81 µs with the local patch. For 32 chunks with all five standard fields present throughout, it falls from 22.4–23.2 µs to 15.2–16.4 µs. All 20 measured input shapes preserve the output and metadata key order.
findings.interpretation: Two coalescing calls have identical execution stacks. The live Task, notification Event and drained output list join records 2 and 3 to the interactive and batch launches in records 0 and 1. The batch launch owns the 32 queued chunks and their per-token annotations. The interactive launch owns two chunks with no incremental metadata fields. Swapping the backlog and launch order moves the coalescing work to the interactive request, whose execution stack has the same frames.
findings.limits: This isolates the streaming backlog item from the original report. The trace uses pinned SGLang frontend methods and prepared detokenizer packets, with the bursts delivered in one event-loop turn. Separate thread-CPU timings use 7 trials per hash seed and 3,000 calls per trial. GPU inference, HTTP transport and client latency are outside the replay. GitHub closed the issue for inactivity. The coalescer remains unchanged at the inspected main commit, and the comparison uses a local patch.

findings_zh.observation: 报告版本与核对的主分支版本使用相同的两段式元数据遍历。32 个积压块中，两个元数据字段到最后四分之一才出现时，本地补丁把每次合并的线程 CPU 时间中位数从 17.0–17.8 微秒降到 9.18–9.81 微秒。每块都包含五个标准字段时，从 22.4–23.2 微秒降到 15.2–16.4 微秒。20 种测量输入的输出内容和元数据键顺序均一致。
findings_zh.interpretation: 两次合并的执行栈相同。核对实际 Task、通知 Event 和取出的输出列表后，执行记录 2 和 3 分别接回交互式与批处理发起记录 0 和 1。批处理入口对应 32 个带逐 token 注释的积压块，交互式入口对应 2 个没有增量元数据字段的积压块。交换积压归属与发起顺序后，处理开销归到交互式请求，执行栈的形状相同。
findings_zh.limits: 实验只覆盖原报告中的流式积压处理。拼接使用固定版本的 SGLang 前端方法和预置解码数据包，在同一轮事件循环内送入积压块。线程 CPU 时间另行测量，每个哈希种子测 7 轮，每轮调用 3000 次。GPU 推理、HTTP 传输及客户端延迟均超出本次实验范围。GitHub 因长期无活动关闭 Issue。已核对的主分支提交仍保留原实现，对照使用本地补丁。

cases.contribution: Matching the live Task, notification Event, and its drained list joins identical coalescer stacks to the interactive and batch launches. The joins identify which launch pays for the 32-chunk backlog and its per-token metadata.
cases.contribution_zh: 核对实际 Task、通知 Event 和取出的列表，把两条相同的合并执行栈接回交互式与批处理入口，确定哪次发起承担了 32 个积压块及其逐 token 元数据的处理开销。

cases.title: Which stream owns each delayed onError callback?
cases.title_zh: 延后的 onError 回调各自属于哪条流？

findings.observation: With the registered callback held, the exact pre-fix StreamingTest rethrows the expected stream error and then fails the list-size assertion. The merged test waits in its latch helper and passes when the callback completes. In a two-caller replay, both captures rethrow the exact original exception while both callback lists remain empty. Checking immediately fails both assertions, and waiting for the callback notification passes both. The two orders produce the same result.
findings.interpretation: Both later user callbacks have identical physical stacks through AiServiceStreamingResponseHandler.onError. The real response handler passed into the threaded mock and the exact Throwable object identify each callback. This joins batch observation 2 to creation 1 and interactive observation 3 to creation 0, even though the later launch records its callback first. Each creation stack reaches the caller's capture and TokenStream.start. Reversing the launches and callback releases preserves the matches. The joins show that capture's terminal observation and the application's callback side effect occur at different points in the same stream.
findings.limits: The JDK 25 replay uses the published LangChain4j 1.24.0 runtime and langchain4j-test 1.24.0-beta34, the pinned pre-merge and merged StreamingTest files, and MockStreamingChatModel with no provider. The release and merge parent have identical relevant onError code, capture helper, and mock. The deterministic control holds only delivery to the user error callback. All ten ordinary merged StreamingTest cases also pass. GitHub still lists issue #7165 as open. The maintained test correction in PR #7217 is merged.

findings_zh.observation: 在用户回调被暂时拦住时，修复前的原版 StreamingTest 如期重新抛出流异常，随后因为列表为空而断言失败。合入版会等在原有的 latch 辅助方法，待回调完成后通过。双调用者对照中，两次 capture 都重新抛出各自的原始异常，此时两个回调列表仍为空。立即断言时两条请求均失败，等待回调通知后均通过。反转发起顺序得到相同结果。
findings_zh.interpretation: 两个随后执行的用户回调在 AiServiceStreamingResponseHandler.onError 中经过完全相同的物理栈。核对交给异步 mock 的实际响应处理器和同一个 Throwable 对象，把批处理记录 2 接到创建记录 1，把交互式记录 3 接到创建记录 0。后发起的回调先写入结果，每条创建栈都包含该调用者的 capture 与 TokenStream.start。反转发起和放行顺序后，两次拼接仍正确。拼接明确了同一条流中，capture 收到终止事件和用户回调写入结果的两个时间点。
findings_zh.limits: JDK 25 实验使用已发布的 LangChain4j 1.24.0、langchain4j-test 1.24.0-beta34、固定版本的修复前及合入版 StreamingTest，以及本地 MockStreamingChatModel。已发布包与合入前提交的相关 onError 源码、capture 帮助类及 mock 一致。受控实验仅暂停用户错误回调。合入版的十项常规 StreamingTest 测试也全部通过。GitHub 上 issue #7165 仍开放，测试修复 PR #7217 已合入。

cases.contribution: The same streaming response handler and exception join each delayed user callback to the capture that had already rethrown that stream's failure. This identifies why the original integration test checked an empty list.
cases.contribution_zh: 用同一个流式响应处理器和异常对象，将延后的用户回调接回已抛出该流异常的 capture，定位原集成测试为何读到了空列表。

cases.title: Which streaming model calls lost their agent trace?
cases.title_zh: 哪些流式模型调用脱离了原始 agent trace？

findings.observation: In Microsoft.Extensions.AI 10.3.0, two streaming requests each produce a tool span and a follow-up chat span with a new TraceId and an empty parent SpanId. Both initial chat spans are connected to their original agent. The same scenario keeps all spans attached in 10.2.0 and 10.4.0. All three versions complete one tool call, two model calls and the same streamed result per request. The results hold on .NET 8 and .NET 10 and in both launch orders.
findings.interpretation: Both disconnected follow-ups have identical physical stacks through OpenTelemetryChatClient and FunctionInvokingChatClient. At each observation, the actual original ChatMessage remains in the follow-up input while its recorded IAsyncEnumerator has an outstanding MoveNextAsync. Matching those object identities connects batch execution record 2 to creation record 1 and interactive execution record 3 to creation record 0. The later launch reaches its follow-up first. Reversing both orders preserves the matches. The original agent TraceIds and caller frames are available after the joins even when the exported follow-up spans form new roots.
findings.limits: The replay runs released Microsoft.Extensions.AI assemblies on .NET 8.0.34 and 10.0.0, with the real OpenTelemetryChatClient and FunctionInvokingChatClient, a local tool, and a scripted model provider as in the upstream regression test. A standard ActivityListener independently records completed spans. The evidence page shows the .NET 8 replay on the affected 10.3.0 package. The issue is closed. Merged PR #7321 guards the Activity.Current assignments after yields, and the 10.4.0 package passes the replay.

findings_zh.observation: Microsoft.Extensions.AI 10.3.0 中，两条流式请求的工具 span 和后续模型 span 各自生成了新的 TraceId，父 SpanId 为空。两条请求的首轮模型 span 仍属于原始 agent。用相同请求测试 10.2.0 和 10.4.0，所有 span 都归于各自的 agent。三个版本中，每条请求都执行一次工具和两次模型调用，最终流式结果一致。上述结果在 .NET 8、.NET 10 和两种发起顺序下均成立。
findings_zh.interpretation: 两个脱离 trace 的后续模型调用，在 OpenTelemetryChatClient 和 FunctionInvokingChatClient 中经过完全相同的物理执行栈。采样时，输入中仍持有发起时的同一个 ChatMessage，记录的 IAsyncEnumerator 也正在推进 MoveNextAsync。用这两个对象的身份，将批处理执行记录 2 接到创建记录 1，将交互式执行记录 3 接到创建记录 0。后发起的请求先到达后续模型调用。反转发起与抵达顺序后，两次拼接仍然正确。后续 span 即使被导出为独立根节点，也能沿拼接找回原始 agent TraceId 和调用入口。
findings_zh.limits: 实验在 .NET 8.0.34 和 10.0.0 上运行已发布的 Microsoft.Extensions.AI 程序集，使用实际 OpenTelemetryChatClient、FunctionInvokingChatClient、本地工具和脚本模型提供方，与上游回归测试的设计一致。标准 ActivityListener 独立记录完成的 span。证据页展示 .NET 8 上受影响的 10.3.0。Issue 已关闭。PR #7321 已合入，在 yield 后保护 Activity.Current 的赋值，10.4.0 通过了本地对照。

cases.contribution: Two identical follow-up stacks carry new native trace IDs. Matching the active enumerator and original ChatMessage object joins each stack to the launch that created its agent trace.
cases.contribution_zh: 两条相同的后续模型调用栈各自带有新的原生 TraceId。核对活跃的异步枚举器及原始 ChatMessage 对象，把每条栈接回创建其 agent trace 的发起入口。

cases.title: Which Ray Serve handles created the background metrics work?
cases.title_zh: Ray Serve 的后台指标汇报由哪些部署句柄创建？

findings.observation: The base runs one cached-metrics Task per deployment handle. The proposal runs one shared Task on the router loop. With 128 idle handles and the default 100 ms interval, the median router-thread CPU per 850 ms window falls from 40.3–42.2 ms to 17.3 ms across two test orders, a 57–59% reduction. With no handles it stays below 0.13 ms. In a separate 16-handle check, the first reporting wave goes from 16 Task wake-ups to one, with the same 16 flushes and exact per-handle counter deltas.
findings.interpretation: The default version has two identical metrics execution stacks on the dedicated router thread. Each live asyncio Task matches the Task stored on its exact RouterMetricsManager. This joins observations 4 and 5 to creation records 1 and 3. The same asyncio Handle returned by call_soon_threadsafe runs during that creation, connecting it across threads to the corresponding DeploymentHandle.options initialization in record 0 or 2. The application frames distinguish chatbot and embedding callers even though both use the same deployment. Asyncio Task debug stacks stop at the common router-side callback. Both launch orders preserve the matches. In the proposal both managers flush in the same shared Task, and the exact registration Handle still recovers each caller.
findings.limits: The comparison runs actual DeploymentHandle.options, router-thread initialization, cached metrics code, and Ray metric calls on Ray 2.59.0 with pinned router.py files. The controller transport is stubbed. The CPU measurement uses five idle windows per configuration and order after warm-up. The wake-up count and joined stacks use separate runs. This measures the local router thread with cached handles and excludes model requests or an external Prometheus scrape. The open proposal passes six upstream tests. In an additional lifecycle check, replacement concurrent with the last handle's shutdown leaves two reporters on the proposed revision. A local patch keeps one, preserves both counter deltas under both registration orders, and passes the same six tests. The issue and PR are open.

findings_zh.observation: 原版为每个部署句柄创建一个缓存指标汇报 Task，候选 PR 则在路由事件循环上运行一个共享 Task。128 个空闲句柄使用默认的 100 毫秒汇报间隔时，两种顺序下，每个 850 毫秒窗口的路由线程 CPU 时间中位数从 40.3–42.2 毫秒降至 17.3 毫秒，减少 57–59%。无句柄时低于 0.13 毫秒。独立的 16 句柄对照中，首轮汇报从唤醒 16 个 Task 减到 1 个，两个版本都刷新了 16 次，逐句柄计数增量一致。
findings_zh.interpretation: 原版的两次指标刷新在路由线程上经过完全相同的执行栈。用各自 RouterMetricsManager 保存的实际 Task，把执行记录 4 和 5 分别接回创建记录 1 和 3。创建发生时正在运行 call_soon_threadsafe 返回的同一个 asyncio Handle，沿它跨线程接回记录 0 或 2 中的 DeploymentHandle.options 初始化，区分使用同一部署的聊天和嵌入调用者。原生 asyncio Task 调试栈只记录共用的路由侧回调。反转初始化顺序后仍能正确归属。候选 PR 中，两个管理器由同一个 Task 汇报，仍可沿实际注册回调接回各自入口。
findings_zh.limits: 组件对照在 Ray 2.59.0 中使用固定版本的 router.py，运行实际 DeploymentHandle.options、路由线程初始化、缓存指标代码和 Ray 指标调用。控制器通信使用本地夹具。每种配置和顺序预热后测五个空闲窗口。唤醒次数与拼接栈由单独实验采集。计时范围为缓存句柄所在的路由线程。模型推理和外部 Prometheus 抓取在实验范围之外。候选 PR 通过六项上游测试。另一个生命周期对照发现，最后一个旧句柄关闭与新句柄注册交叠时，候选 PR 会留下两个汇报任务。本地补丁在两种注册顺序下均维持一个任务，两个句柄的计数增量一致，也通过上述六项测试。Issue 与 PR 均开放。

cases.contribution: The live reporting Task and the exact cross-thread scheduling Handle join two identical metric flush stacks to separate deployment-handle initializers. The base's per-handle wake-ups explain the extra router CPU against the shared reporter control.
cases.contribution_zh: 实际指标汇报 Task 和跨线程调度的同一个 asyncio Handle，把两条相同的指标刷新栈分别接回部署句柄的初始化。与共享汇报任务对照后，可将原版增加的路由线程 CPU 开销归到逐句柄唤醒。

cases.title: Which requests waited behind SGLang's single Rust tokenizer?
cases.title_zh: SGLang 的单线程 Rust 分词器让哪些请求排队？

findings.observation: Each burst sends eight ordinary text requests of 8,070 tokens through the Rust HTTP frontend. With one tokenizer thread on the base, the median of the longest queue wait per burst is 102.7–103.1 ms across two launch orders. The proposal chooses four workers on the eight-core frontend set, reducing that wait to 12.5–12.7 ms. Manually selecting four workers on the base gives 12.5–12.7 ms as well. The full tokenizer window falls from 125.5–125.7 ms to 34.7–35.3 ms with the proposal. Each encode still takes about 16 ms, and the scheduler receives identical token IDs for every request in all arms.
findings.interpretation: On the single-worker base the two native tokenizer execution stacks are identical. The full internal request ID matches each worker dequeue with the same request's enqueue, its Tokio HTTP Task, and the scheduler-ring input. Execution records 3 and 5 join to request creation records 2 and 4. The public ID sent in the local HTTP request and echoed in its response joins each HTTP Task to launcher record 0 or 1. Reversing the launch order preserves both matches. The manual four-worker control attributes the improvement to overlapping tokenization and shorter queue waits.
findings.limits: The loopback replay runs pinned SGLang Rust HTTP, TokenizerManager, the native tokenizer pool, and the scheduler ring. It uses Google's Gemma 4 31B instruction tokenizer, plain-text /generate, and a local scheduler fixture that returns one real token ID per request. Each arm runs five timed bursts per order after one warm-up. The separate two-request stack capture does not enter those timings. The server, processor, and encoding crate use optimization level 2 with debug information. The measured interval starts at the tokenizer enqueue and ends at the sample or encode completion. The upstream report measures client latency on a GPU deployment. The proposal's upstream pool-size unit test passed locally. The issue and PR are open.

findings_zh.observation: 每轮由 Rust HTTP 前端处理 8 条普通文本请求，每条 8070 个 token。原版只有一个分词线程，两种发起顺序下，每轮最慢排队时间的中位数为 102.7–103.1 毫秒。候选 PR 在 8 核前端自动启动 4 个分词线程，把中位数降至 12.5–12.7 毫秒。原版手动配置 4 个分词线程时，同样为 12.5–12.7 毫秒。候选 PR 使整轮分词区间从 125.5–125.7 毫秒降至 34.7–35.3 毫秒。每条请求分词本身仍约为 16 毫秒，所有对照下调度器收到的 token ID 逐一一致。
findings_zh.interpretation: 单线程原版中的两条原生分词执行栈完全相同。用完整的内部请求 ID，把每次工作线程出队接回同一请求的入队、Tokio HTTP Task 和调度器输入。执行记录 3 和 5 分别接到请求创建记录 2 和 4。再用本地 HTTP 请求发出、服务端响应返回的公开 ID，接回记录 0 和 1 的原始入口。反转发起顺序后，两条拼接仍然正确。原版四线程对照表明，改善来自分词并行后排队缩短。
findings_zh.limits: 本地回环实验使用固定版本的 SGLang Rust HTTP 前端、TokenizerManager、原生分词线程池和调度器环形队列。它用官方 Gemma 4 31B 指令模型的 tokenizer，经 /generate 接收纯文本，由调度器夹具为每条请求返回真实 token ID。每种配置与顺序先预热一次，再计时五轮。双请求调用栈在单独一轮采集。服务端、处理器和实际分词依赖以优化等级 2 构建，保留调试信息。计时从分词入队开始，到工作线程取出请求或完成编码为止。上游报告关注 GPU 部署下的客户端延迟。候选 PR 的线程数单元测试已在本地通过。Issue 与 PR 均开放。

cases.contribution: The same internal request ID joins two identical tokenizer worker stacks to their Tokio HTTP Tasks. The HTTP request and echoed response IDs recover the original launchers and distinguish which caller incurred each queue wait.
cases.contribution_zh: 相同的内部请求 ID 将两条相同的分词执行栈分别接回对应的 Tokio HTTP Task。HTTP 请求与响应中的公开 ID 再接到最初的发起入口，区分每次排队等待属于哪个调用方。

cases.title: Which Ray Serve requests launch each cold model load?
cases.title_zh: Ray Serve 的每次冷加载由哪个请求发起？

findings.observation: On the base, whichever request starts second waits for the first model's entire load. The replay observes its pending Future in the replica-wide asyncio.Lock. With the patch in PR #65825, the median start delay is under 0.8 ms for each model, and the median overlap is 45.1 ms. The median time for the pair falls from 111.4 ms to 66.2 ms in both launch orders. An extra request for the same model receives the same model object and leaves the loader count at one for that model. Repeated warm requests return the same objects with no extra loads.
findings.interpretation: The two loader Tasks have identical execution stacks on the same event-loop thread. The actual Task in the replica's model-ID map joins sampled loaders 4 and 5 to Task creations 2 and 3. At each creation the active request Task joins that record again to the interactive or batch entry in records 0 and 1. Each request receives the exact model object produced by its matched loader. Asyncio debug reports the common spawn site and omits both launchers. Reversing the launch order preserves both matches and reverses the waiting request on the base.
findings.limits: The component replay uses public @serve.multiplexed on Ray 2.59.0 with the pinned multiplex.py from each arm. It uses one in-process replica context, two model slots, and async model-load fixtures with 45 and 65 ms waits. Each configuration and launch order has one warm-up, five timed trials, and a separate trace. Real model weights, GPU transfers, and proxy traffic are outside the measurement. Three upstream tests pass on the proposal covering overlapping loads, one shared load per model ID, and the capacity limit. The issue and PR are open.

findings_zh.observation: 原版中，后启动的请求等待先启动的请求完成整个模型加载。其待完成的 Future 出现在副本共用的 asyncio.Lock 等待队列中。使用 PR #65825 后，中位数下两次加载均在提交后 0.8 毫秒内开始，重叠约 45.1 毫秒。两种发起顺序下，成对请求的总耗时中位数均从 111.4 毫秒降至 66.2 毫秒。额外请求同一模型时，两个调用返回同一对象，该模型仍只加载一次。后续请求命中缓存，仍返回原对象。
findings_zh.interpretation: 两个模型加载 Task 在同一事件循环线程上经过完全相同的执行栈。核对副本按模型 ID 保存的实际 Task，将执行记录 4 和 5 分别接回加载 Task 的创建记录 2 和 3。再用创建当时正在运行的请求 Task，把它们分别接回记录 0 和 1 的交互式或批处理入口。两个请求都收到了各自加载 Task 返回的同一个模型对象。asyncio 原生调试只记录共用的启动路径，缺少两个入口。反转发起顺序后，两条拼接仍正确，原版中等待的一方随之交换。
findings_zh.limits: 组件实验在 Ray 2.59.0 上通过公开接口 @serve.multiplexed 运行两个固定版本的 multiplex.py，使用进程内副本上下文、两个模型槽位和分别等待 45 与 65 毫秒的模拟模型加载器。每个版本和发起顺序均预热一次、计时五次并另采一次调用栈。计时范围为加载协调，真实权重加载、GPU 传输和代理流量在实验范围之外。候选 PR 通过三项上游测试，覆盖不同模型并行加载、同一模型共享一次加载及容量限制。Issue 与 PR 均开放。

cases.contribution: Matching the live loader Task and its active creating request recovers both request entries from identical post-patch loader stacks. On the base, the same request identities show which cold load waited behind the other model.
cases.contribution_zh: 核对实际运行的加载 Task 及创建时的请求 Task，从候选修复后的两条相同加载栈恢复各自的请求入口。用相同的请求身份方法核对原版，可确定哪次冷加载排在另一模型后面。

cases.title: Which SGLang requests pay for repeated Kimi special-token lookups?
cases.title_zh: SGLang 哪些请求承担了 Kimi 特殊 token 的重复查询？

findings.observation: With the Kimi-K2-Thinking tokenizer and Transformers 5.3.0, three incremental detokenizer packets of 1,024 rows use 4.27–4.37 s of thread CPU time with the old default and 51.7–52.2 ms with PR #23409's cached default. For 128 rows, the medians are 530–547 ms and 6.43–6.48 ms. Every text fragment and output token ID matches. Enabling the cache on the base and disabling it on the merged revision reproduce the corresponding timing regimes. With special-token filtering off, the 128-row control stays around 5 ms on both defaults.
findings.interpretation: Two identical decode stacks in one worker belong to different rows of the same scheduler packet. Matching each live token list to its row and using that row's request ID joins execution records 2 and 3 to frontend Task creations 0 and 1. Both Tasks receive the expected result via the actual ZeroMQ IPC and TokenizerManager response path. Reversing the launches and packet rows preserves the matches. The old path computes all_special_ids 20 times for each traced row. The warmed cache avoids all 20 original property evaluations on each row.
findings.limits: The CPU replay uses the pinned detokenizer and the official Kimi tokenizer with prepared incremental token IDs. Five measured trials follow one warm-up per default and order. Each trial measures all three detokenizer packets, including incremental assembly. The identity evidence traces a separate two-row local IPC replay and the genuine frontend response coroutine. These measurements cover the detokenizer component. The upstream issue reports client inter-token latency on a larger GPU deployment. The issue is closed and the default change is merged.

findings_zh.observation: 使用 Kimi-K2-Thinking tokenizer 和 Transformers 5.3.0 时，连续三个各含 1024 行的增量解码包，在旧默认配置下耗时 4.27–4.37 秒线程 CPU 时间。采用 PR #23409 默认开启的缓存后，中位数降至 51.7–52.2 毫秒。128 行的中位数从 530–547 毫秒降至 6.43–6.48 毫秒。所有文本片段和输出 token ID 均一致。在原版显式开启缓存、在合入版显式关闭缓存，分别复现了对应的耗时。关闭特殊 token 过滤的 128 行对照在两版中都约 5 毫秒。
findings_zh.interpretation: 一个解码线程上出现两条相同的执行栈，分别属于同一调度数据包中的两行。核对实际 token 列表的位置，再通过该行的请求 ID，将执行记录 2 和 3 接回前端 Task 创建记录 0 和 1。两条 Task 均经实际 ZeroMQ IPC 和 TokenizerManager 响应路径收到预期结果。反转发起顺序及包内行顺序后仍能正确归属。旧版每行调用原始 all_special_ids 属性计算 20 次，缓存预热后每行省去这 20 次计算。
findings_zh.limits: CPU 实验使用固定版本的解码组件、官方 Kimi tokenizer 和预置增量 token ID。每种默认配置和测试顺序先预热一次，再测五次，计时包含三个解码包的增量文本处理。拼接证据来自两行的本地 IPC 实验及实际前端响应协程。本次测量针对解码组件。上游报告关注更大规模 GPU 部署的客户端 token 间延迟。Issue 已关闭，默认配置改动已合入。

cases.contribution: Two equal token rows enter identical decoder stacks. Their actual positions and request IDs join each worker observation to the frontend Task that receives its text, attributing the repeated special-token work.
cases.contribution_zh: 两行内容相同的 token 经过相同的解码栈。核对其实际行位置及请求 ID，把每次工作线程观测接回接收其文本的前端 Task，定位特殊 token 重复计算属于哪个请求。

cases.title: Which Ray Serve streams spend their first-token delay in batching?
cases.title_zh: Ray Serve 哪条请求流的首 token 延迟主要来自批处理？

findings.observation: The first response reaches the Ray replica caller in about 46 ms in both streams. On PR #67968 the interactive stream has about 5 ms below the engine boundary and 40 ms of first-chunk egress. The batch stream has about 33 ms below the engine boundary and 12 ms of egress. The baseline emits none of the proposal's five latency observations. Pooling 20 requests with one model tag, subtracting the separate p95 values for ingress and egress from the TTFT p95 gives 5.2 ms. The p95 of the request-paired engine intervals is 33.4 ms. A local patch measures that engine p95 directly and reports 33.4 ms in the matched replay.
findings.interpretation: Both first chunks enter an actual Batcher queue through identical execution frames. Matching the live reader Task, its Batcher, and the exact queue joins records 4 and 5 to their creation records 2 and 3. The request Tasks that created those readers join to interactive and batch launches 0 and 1. The exact first-chunk strings make the same trip from the engine through the queue and into each caller's first emission. Asyncio debug gives the common spawn path and omits the original launchers. Both launch orders preserve the matches.
findings.limits: The replay runs pinned Ray LLMServer stream handling, Batcher, and the proposed Ray Histogram calls with a local engine fixture and a 45 ms batching interval. Five runs per arm and launch order use one shared model tag. Percentiles are calculated from raw histogram observations at the replica boundary. The tests cover that boundary and exclude model execution and router or proxy queueing. The proposal passes its 12 upstream tests. The local patch also passes the test that pairs the engine histogram with a caller's first emission. The issue and proposal are open.

findings_zh.observation: 两条流在 Ray 副本边界的首包都约为 46 毫秒。使用候选 PR #67968 时，交互式流在引擎侧约 5 毫秒，首包输出约 40 毫秒。批处理流在引擎侧约 33 毫秒，首包输出约 12 毫秒。原版在这个路径上没有候选 PR 新增的五类延迟观测。汇总 20 个具有相同模型标签的请求，拿 TTFT 的 p95 减去进入和输出开销各自的 p95，得到 5.2 毫秒。逐请求配对后再求引擎侧 p95，得到 33.4 毫秒。本地补丁直接记录引擎侧区间，对照测得的 p95 同为 33.4 毫秒。
findings_zh.interpretation: 两个首块进入实际 Batcher 队列时，执行栈完全相同。核对运行中的读取 Task、所属 Batcher 和同一个队列，把观测记录 4 与 5 分别接到创建记录 2 与 3。创建读取 Task 的请求 Task 再接回记录 0 与 1 的交互式和批处理入口。两条流分别核对了引擎送出、队列接收和调用方收到的同一个首块对象。原生 asyncio 调试记录相同的创建路径，缺少最初的发起入口。反转发起顺序仍能正确归属。
findings_zh.limits: 实验运行固定版本的 Ray LLMServer 流式处理、Batcher 和候选 PR 的 Ray Histogram 记录方法，使用本地模拟引擎和 45 毫秒批处理间隔。每个版本与发起顺序各运行五次，两条流使用同一个模型标签。分位数来自副本边界上的原始直方图观测。验证范围为该边界，模型执行和路由器、代理排队不在实验范围内。候选 PR 的 12 项上游测试均通过。本地补丁另核对引擎指标只在调用方收到首包时记录。Issue 和 PR 仍开放。

cases.contribution: The exact reader Task, Batcher queue, and creating request Task join identical first-chunk enqueue stacks to distinct callers. This identifies which equal-TTFT stream spent its time below the engine boundary and which waited for batching.
cases.contribution_zh: 核对读取 Task、Batcher 队列和创建它的请求 Task，把相同的首块入队栈接回各自的调用者，区分两个首包时间相同的流中，哪条耗在引擎侧，哪条耗在输出批处理。

cases.title: Which Dynamo endpoint registration is waiting for its first canary?
cases.title_zh: Dynamo 哪次端点注册正在等待首次就绪检查？

findings.observation: With a two-second idle interval, the median time from registration to Ready is 2,003–2,005 ms on the base and 5.1–5.2 ms with open PR #18672 for a worker that succeeds on its first check. For the worker that fails once, the medians are 4,007 ms and 1,006–1,008 ms. In one separate comparison at the default ten-second setting, the successful worker reaches Ready in 10.004 s and 4.8 ms. The retrying worker reaches Ready in 20.005 s and 1.004 s. It stays NotReady after its first failure in every run.
findings.interpretation: The two native timer-expiry stacks and their spawn stacks are identical on the Tokio thread. Each live Task ID matches the ID returned by its JoinHandle, linking execution records 4 and 5 to creation records 2 and 3. The same registered Arc<Notify> joins the shared spawn site back to records 0 and 1, where the interactive and batch endpoints register. Reversing registration order swaps the launchers attached to those paths on both revisions. The join attributes the identical timer samples to a worker that passes immediately and a worker that must retry.
findings.limits: The comparison runs the original Rust DistributedRuntime and health-check manager with local fixture engines and in-memory discovery. Timings are registration to the first observed Ready state on one Tokio thread. The two-second measurements use three runs per arm and order and exclude stack collection. The default interval has one comparison. The local experiment has no Kubernetes probe or model-startup time. All 13 baseline and 16 proposal health-check tests pass using their loopback QUIC fixture. The issue and PR are open.

findings_zh.observation: 空闲检查间隔设为 2 秒时，首次检查成功的 worker 从注册到就绪的时间中位数由 2003–2005 毫秒降至 5.1–5.2 毫秒。首次失败一次的 worker 由约 4007 毫秒降至 1006–1008 毫秒。默认 10 秒配置另做了一组对照，首次成功的 worker 从 10.004 秒降至 4.8 毫秒，需重试的 worker 从 20.005 秒降至 1.004 秒。在所有对照中，首次失败后端点仍为未就绪。
findings_zh.interpretation: 两次计时器到期的原生执行栈相同，两条 Task 的创建栈也相同。运行中的 Tokio Task ID 与创建时 JoinHandle 的 ID 一致，使执行记录 4 接到创建记录 2，5 接到 3。再通过端点注册时的同一个 Arc<Notify>，把共同的创建位置分别接到交互式和批处理注册记录 0 与 1。两个版本都反转注册顺序核对归属。拼接区分了使用同一执行路径的两个 worker，其中一个首次检查成功，另一个必须重试。
findings_zh.limits: 组件实验运行原始 Rust DistributedRuntime 和健康检查管理器，使用本地模拟引擎及内存发现服务。计时为单 Tokio 线程上从注册到首次观测到就绪的时长。2 秒配置下每种顺序和版本测三次，计时轮关闭栈采集。10 秒配置仅做一组对照。实验覆盖端点就绪状态，未包含模型加载或 Kubernetes 探针耗时。上游健康检查套件使用回环 QUIC 测试环境，基准版本 13 项、候选版本 16 项均通过。Issue 和 PR 仍开放。

cases.contribution: The live Tokio Task and the registration notifier join identical timer-expiry stacks to two worker registrations. The joins identify which worker waited for its first check and which also had to retry.
cases.contribution_zh: 实际 Tokio Task 和注册通知对象把相同的计时器执行栈接回两次 worker 注册，区分了等待首次检查的 worker 和需要额外重试的 worker。

cases.title: Which Dynamo stream incurs the repeated token-prefix scans?
cases.title_zh: Dynamo 的重复 token 前缀扫描属于哪条请求流？

findings.observation: The pinned Dynamo Python frontend repeatedly copies the token-ID prefix while the vLLM DeepSeek-R1 parser scans it for a reasoning delimiter. At 8,192 single-token reasoning chunks, two run orders give median frontend thread CPU times of 328–330 ms for the base and 120–121 ms for PR #18728. At 16,384 chunks, the medians are 1,097–1,100 ms and 243–245 ms. The per-chunk envelopes, final content, and token usage match in every arm after removing the wall-clock created field. The proposed token-prefix implementation passes all eight selected upstream tests.
findings.interpretation: The two parser samples have identical execution frames on one event-loop thread. The actual Task and async-generator frame identify each request's postprocessor, joining record 4 to 2 and 5 to 3 at the common dispatch site. The same scheduled asyncio Handle and request object reach records 0 and 1, the interactive and batch submissions. Stock asyncio debug Task creation traceback reaches dispatch and omits the two application launchers. The joins follow the right request in both launch orders on both revisions. The interactive request performs 66 parser calls and the batch request performs 258.
findings.limits: The component replay runs Dynamo's original _generate_and_stream and StreamingPostProcessor with vLLM 0.33.0's DeepSeek-R1 parser. It supplies prepared token chunks in process and substitutes the detokenizer interface. The benchmark measures thread CPU for stream consumption on CPython 3.12.4, with a warm-up and five measured trials per arm per order. Model inference, transport, and other parser families were outside the comparison. The issue and candidate PR are open.

findings_zh.observation: 固定版本的 Dynamo Python 前端反复复制 token ID 前缀，vLLM 的 DeepSeek-R1 解析器会扫描此前的前缀以查找推理结束标记。每段包含一个推理 token 时，两种运行顺序下，8192 段的前端线程 CPU 时间中位数从 328–330 毫秒降到 120–121 毫秒，16384 段从 1097–1100 毫秒降到 243–245 毫秒。移除响应的 created 时间字段后，两边的逐段响应、最终文本和 token 统计均一致。候选 PR #18728 的 8 项前缀测试均通过。
findings_zh.interpretation: 两次解析观测在同一个事件循环线程上，物理执行栈相同。实际 Task 和异步生成器帧确认各自的后处理器，观测记录 4 接到创建记录 2，5 接到 3，两者都由同一个 dispatch 位置创建。核对同一个 asyncio Handle 和请求对象，再分别接到记录 0 的交互式发起入口和记录 1 的批处理入口。原生 asyncio 调试创建栈只回到 dispatch，缺少这两个入口。两个版本、两种发起顺序下均能正确归属。交互式请求调用解析器 66 次，批处理请求调用 258 次。
findings_zh.limits: 组件实验运行 Dynamo 原始的 _generate_and_stream、StreamingPostProcessor 和 vLLM 0.33.0 的 DeepSeek-R1 解析器，以进程内的预置 token 流驱动，并用实验接口替代实际解码。CPython 3.12.4 上记录消费完整流的线程 CPU 时间，每种顺序、每个版本先预热一次再测量五次。测试范围限于该前端组件及上述解析器。Issue 和候选 PR 仍开放。

cases.contribution: The same parser stack serves two requests. Matching the actual Task, generator frame, and dispatch Handle restores the interactive and batch submissions and assigns repeated prefix processing to each stream.
cases.contribution_zh: 两条请求流经过相同的解析执行栈。核对实际 Task、生成器帧和调度 Handle 后，分别找回交互式与批处理提交入口，并把重复的前缀处理归到各自的请求流。

cases.title: Which HTTP streams incur a Ray Serve deployment hop?
cases.title_zh: 哪些 HTTP 流经过了 Ray Serve 的跨部署转发？

findings.observation: On Ray 2.45.0, 32 concurrent HTTP streams each send 64 ordered events. Forwarding each event separately transfers 2,048 Ray results and delivers 3,250–3,476 events/s across two benchmark orders. Flushing the first event immediately and grouping the rest by eight lowers the count to 288 and delivers 8,787–8,802 events/s. The co-located generator bypasses the deployment hop and delivers about 9,200 events/s. All three arms return exactly the same event contents and order.
findings.interpretation: At the Ray result wrapper both physical stacks are identical. The live DeploymentResponseGenerator, actual ActorReplicaResult and owning Python async-generator frame connect each read to the creation of its HTTP response body. Record 1 joins to launch_lookup through record 0, and record 3 joins to launch_summary through record 2. The same two stacks belong to the opposite routes when the clients start in reverse order.
findings.limits: The benchmark uses a local HTTP ingress and two actual Serve replicas with synthetic SSE output, five runs per arm in each of two benchmark orders. Throughput counts events at the client, and grouping changes arrival cadence. The co-located path isolates the extra deployment hop in Ray 2.45.0. The reporter closed the issue after HAProxy and direct streaming became available. The tested workaround is application-side grouping.

findings_zh.observation: Ray 2.45.0 在 32 个并发 HTTP 流中各发送 64 个有序事件。逐事件跨部署转发需要 2048 次 Ray 结果交接，两种测试顺序下吞吐为每秒 3250–3476 个事件。首个事件立即发送，其余每 8 个一组后，交接降到 288 次，吞吐为每秒 8787–8802 个。生成器与入口同部署时，省去跨部署转发，吞吐约为每秒 9200 个。三种路径的事件内容和顺序一致。
findings_zh.interpretation: 两次读取经过同一个 Ray 结果包装器，物理执行栈完全相同。核对实际 DeploymentResponseGenerator、ActorReplicaResult 和所属的 Python 异步生成器帧，可以把读取接回 HTTP 响应体的创建位置。观测 1 接回记录 0 的 launch_lookup，观测 3 接回记录 2 的 launch_summary。反转客户端发起顺序后，相同执行栈分别归到交换后的路由。
findings_zh.limits: 实验使用本地 HTTP 入口、两个实际的 Serve 副本和合成 SSE 输出，两种测试顺序下每种配置各跑五次。吞吐按客户端收到的事件计数，分组会改变到达节奏。同部署对照用于隔离 Ray 2.45.0 上的跨部署转发开销。报告者在 HAProxy 和直接流式传输可用后关闭了 Issue，本次测试验证的是应用侧分组方案。

cases.contribution: The actual response body, Serve handle and Ray result connect each identical streaming read to its HTTP route. The join identifies which application response uses each inter-deployment stream.
cases.contribution_zh: 核对真实响应体、Serve handle 和 Ray 结果，把相同的流式读取栈接回各自的 HTTP 路由，定位跨部署流属于哪个应用响应。

cases.title: Which vLLM startup Task launched each background KV pin?
cases.title_zh: vLLM 每次后台 KV 内存注册是哪个启动 Task 发起的？

findings.observation: With 512 MiB of host KV storage on one A100, worker registration takes a median of 126.5–143.6 ms on the base and 123.6–124.4 ms on the draft's synchronous path. With the draft's async option it returns in about 0.10 ms. The worker becomes ready 129.4–134.2 ms after entry when polling begins immediately. An independent GPU reduction completes before readiness in all ten async trials, and both ends of the host buffer pass the real DMA round trip. At 1 GiB in the loopback service, the async draft's first HTTP completion arrives 279 ms before the connector-ready log with eager execution and 292 ms before it with CUDA graph capture. In the graph run, host registration starts after capture finishes. All six service runs return the same completion text, finish reason, and count of four tokens.
findings.interpretation: The two background pin_tensor returns have identical frames on separate native threads. The actual Thread, AsyncHostBuffer and allocation callback join each pin to the construction scheduled in get_init_state. The active initialization Task connects that construction to launch_interactive or launch_batch. The same mapping holds when launch order is reversed.
findings.limits: The worker component uses the pinned base and draft with actual CUDA registration and DMA. Its fixture provides the KV layout and bridges PyTorch device APIs. All 37 selected readiness and host-buffer tests pass in a separate CPU run. The loopback comparison uses a seeded tiny Llama, Triton attention, and the base revision's CUDA wheel files with each pinned Python tree. It runs each of the three connector configurations once per execution mode and measures the HTTP reply order relative to the worker readiness log. The issue and draft PR remain open.

findings_zh.observation: 单张 A100 上设置 512 MiB CPU KV 缓存。原版工作器注册耗时中位数为 126.5–143.6 毫秒，候选 PR 的同步路径为 123.6–124.4 毫秒。启用异步后，注册入口约 0.10 毫秒返回，紧接着开始轮询时，工作器从进入注册到就绪需 129.4–134.2 毫秒。十次异步试验中，独立 GPU 归约均在工作器就绪前完成。CPU 缓存首尾均通过真实 DMA 往返核对。回环服务改用 1 GiB 缓存后，异步组的首条 HTTP 结果早于连接器就绪日志，eager 模式提前 279 毫秒，CUDA Graph 模式提前 292 毫秒。CUDA Graph 组在捕获结束后才开始后台注册。六次服务运行的输出文本、结束原因和 4 个 token 的计数一致。
findings_zh.interpretation: 两个 pin_tensor 从不同原生线程返回，执行栈完全相同。核对真实 Thread、AsyncHostBuffer 和分配回调，将后台注册接回 get_init_state 内的创建栈，再沿实际初始化 Task 接回 launch_interactive 或 launch_batch。反转发起顺序后，归属仍正确。
findings_zh.limits: 组件对照运行固定的原版和候选工作器，实际调用 CUDA 注册和 DMA。实验提供 KV 布局，并适配本地 CUDA 环境的 PyTorch 设备 API。独立的 CPU 测试通过所选的 37 项就绪和内存缓冲区测试。回环服务使用固定随机种子的小型 Llama、Triton attention 和原版 CUDA wheel 文件，分别加载两版固定的 Python 代码。每种执行模式下三组连接器配置各运行一次，比较 HTTP 首次响应和就绪日志的先后。Issue 和候选 PR 均仍开放。

cases.contribution: Two native pinning threads have identical execution stacks. Matching the Thread and AsyncHostBuffer objects joins each observation to the separate startup Task that initiated it.
cases.contribution_zh: 两条后台注册线程的执行栈相同。核对真实 Thread 和 AsyncHostBuffer，将每条观测接回各自的启动 Task。

cases.title: Which TEI pipeline waits for a ready-batch slot?
cases.title_zh: TEI 哪条推理流水线正在等预取通道的空位？

findings.observation: While the backend holds its first dequeued batch, capacity one already allows one more batch to be prepared. The local capacity-four option allows four. Both launch orders return the same seven embeddings per pipeline. In the real CPU router, capacity four has a small throughput gain for single-request batches and a small loss when batching up to four requests. The returned vectors match the default and upstream router in both comparisons.
findings.interpretation: Both batching tasks return Pending while reserving a slot and have identical native stacks on the same Tokio thread. The actual Task ID and sender channel join each sample to its spawn site. The original initialization Task joins that creation back to launch_catalog or launch_search. Reversing both launches swaps their ownership of the same two stacks.
findings.limits: The traced experiment intentionally pauses the backend after its first dequeue and uses a real Candle CPU model. Timings come from separate uninstrumented loopback runs with bge-micro and two token budgets. They cover the tested CPU workload. The capacity option was tested locally and the GitHub issue is open.

findings_zh.observation: 后端取走首批并处于受控暂停期间，默认容量已能预取 1 批，本地选项设为 4 后可预取 4 批。两种发起顺序下，每条流水线均返回相同的 7 个 embedding。真实 CPU 路由器中，容量 4 在单请求批次下吞吐略有提高，在最多 4 个请求一批时吞吐略有下降。两种对照中，向量与默认配置及原版一致。
findings_zh.interpretation: 两条批处理任务申请通道空位时均返回 Pending，并且在同一个 Tokio 线程上得到完全相同的原生执行栈。用实际 Task ID 和发送通道把观测接回各自的创建位置，再沿实际初始化 Task 接回 launch_catalog 或 launch_search。反转发起顺序后，同样两条执行栈的归属随之交换。
findings_zh.limits: 栈采集实验在后端取走首批后有意暂停，并运行真实 Candle CPU 模型。耗时来自另一组无插桩的回环测试，使用 bge-micro 和两种 token 预算，结论适用于测试的 CPU 工作负载。容量选项已在本地测试，GitHub Issue 仍开放。
