cases.title: Which application opened the pool whose cancelling worker stalls shutdown?
cases.title_zh: 取消后仍等待的连接池 worker，来自哪个应用入口？

findings.observation: One reported silent-loopback connect/shutdown scenario with psycopg3.3.9, psycopg-pool3.3.3 and CPython3.12.16 accepts one connection. At0.604s after startup, asyncio.run is still in _cancel_all_tasks; worker0 is unfinished with cancelling()=1 at pool_async.py:679 awaiting q.get. Other pool workers are cancelled. Preparation and the sole run take76.80s. The diagnostic callback saves evidence and exits the process0.
findings.interpretation: The actual Task address0x79ac9a18c100 independently matches asyncio.all_tasks, the pool-held worker reference and the generic CoroPerf creation/sample records. CoroPerf recovers start_connection_pool from the worker creation stack, absent from its later native/current wait stack and unavailable in native debug creation traces. The same worker has a scoped CancelledError observation in _connect/_add_connection before returning to queue wait. The focused capture has30 attributed observations; the catalogue highlights one cancellation observation and the last wait snapshot. The source report already describes cancellation swallowing; the added fact is historical application ownership.
findings.limits: This proves a bounded shutdown stall, not infinite duration. asyncio.run does not return normally: the observer calls os._exit(0), closing owned loopback sockets. No pool.close workaround, fix, extra cancellation, reset path, other version or replay was tested. start_connection_pool is a submission helper introduced in this standalone harness. No exception-object identity was captured, so propagation records are not counted as distinct errors. A file-scoped exception probe supplements generic Task birth/sample capture; the original graph is preserved and the focused graph selects only the independently identified worker, without synthesizing runtime events.

findings_zh.observation: psycopg3.3.9、psycopg-pool3.3.3、CPython3.12.16 运行一次报告中的本机静默端口连接/退出场景，真实接受一个连接。启动后0.604秒，asyncio.run 仍在 _cancel_all_tasks 中，worker0 的 cancelling()=1，未结束且在 pool_async.py:679 等待 q.get；其他 worker 已取消。准备及唯一一次运行共76.80秒。诊断回调保存证据后直接退出进程0。
findings_zh.interpretation: 真实 Task 地址0x79ac9a18c100 在 asyncio.all_tasks、连接池持有的 worker 引用和通用 CoroPerf 创建/采样记录中一致。CoroPerf 从历史创建栈恢复 start_connection_pool，而稍后的原生/当前等待栈没有该入口，原生 debug 创建栈也未启用。同一 worker 先在 _connect/_add_connection 留下 CancelledError 观察，随后回到队列等待。聚焦捕获的30个观察均得到归属；目录展示一个取消观察与最后等待快照。报告已说明吞取消根因，新增事实是历史应用入口归属。
findings_zh.limits: 只证明有界退出卡顿，不声称永久等待。asyncio.run 没有正常返回；观察器调用 os._exit(0)，由进程退出关闭其本机套接字。未测试 pool.close 绕行、修复、额外取消、reset 路径、其他版本或重放。start_connection_pool 是该独立 harness 增加的提交辅助函数。没有异常对象身份，不能把传播记录算成多个独立错误。文件范围异常探针补充通用 Task 创建/采样；保留原始 graph，聚焦图只筛选原生引用独立确认的 worker，不生成运行时事件。

cases.contribution: Recover the application pool-opening entry for the exact native worker seen swallowing cancellation and later awaiting its queue.
cases.contribution_zh: 为原生引用确认的同一个 worker 恢复应用打开连接池的入口，并关联连接取消与稍后的队列等待。

cases.title: Which cancelled entry task left the Connection reused by an uncommitted transaction?
cases.title_zh: 后续事务未提交，Connection 之前由哪个取消的入口任务使用？

findings.observation: One real transaction-entry cancellation at affected client checkout99356800 leaves the reused Connection at transaction depth1/INTRANS. A later transaction context exits normally, but the same Connection sees1 inserted row and an independent Connection sees0. Explicit rollback raises ProgrammingError. The successful process exits0 and connections/table/private PostgreSQL are cleaned up. Later-batch startup through success takes28.79s; one preceding observer failure in that batch occurred before cancellation.
findings.interpretation: Generic CoroPerf Task creation plus a file-scoped cancellation exception observation restores launch_interrupted_entry. An API-boundary observation after the later transaction exits restores launch_reuse_check. Both helpers are absent from current observation stacks and present in the causal stacks. An explicit Connection/Task observer independently binds the cancelled-entry Task, later reuse Task and rollback failure to the same actual Connection, showing depth1/INTRANS across phases. The two selected joins are3→5 and29→31. A later cleanup Task reuses the reuse Task address, but its distinct runtime generation prevents joining their records.
findings.limits: This tests exact checkout99356800e90aa0e7b604f652d714ef0f33422b47 using cached CPython3.14.3/PostgreSQL17.1/pure-Python libpq, whereas the report used3.14.8/18.4. The checkout reads version3.3.9 from installed distribution metadata; this is not a released3.3.9 behavior claim. Connection and context-manager wrapper identities require the explicit API observer; generic Task ancestry does not infer shared resources or hidden AsyncTransaction identity. Submission helpers are introduced for this standalone harness. The source already describes stack cleanup; the added diagnostic facts are historical callers and observed cross-phase resource state. Two earlier observer failures are retained, one in b14 and one in b15; neither reached cancellation. No successful scenario replay, nested-savepoint test, alternate server/implementation/version or fix run. The later reuse block runs in a separate Task for this controlled attribution component; the original report runs that block inline in main. No original production Task topology is claimed.

findings_zh.observation: 受影响 client 提交99356800 的一次真实事务入口取消，使连接保留事务深度1/INTRANS。后续事务上下文正常退出，但同一 Connection 看见1行 INSERT，独立 Connection 看见0行；显式 rollback 抛出 ProgrammingError。成功进程退出0，连接、表和私有 PostgreSQL 均清理。后续批次从开始到成功28.79秒；同批更早的一次观察器失败发生在取消之前。
findings_zh.interpretation: 通用 CoroPerf Task 创建与文件范围取消异常观察恢复 launch_interrupted_entry，后续事务退出后的 API 边界观察恢复 launch_reuse_check。两个辅助入口均不在当前观察栈中，而在 causal 栈中恢复。额外的 Connection/Task 观察把取消入口任务、后续复用任务与 rollback 失败独立接到同一真实 Connection，跨阶段记录到深度1/INTRANS。目录选取3→5、29→31两条创建关联。稍后的清理 Task 复用了复用任务的对象地址，但运行时 generation 不同，没有把两者记录混在一起。
findings_zh.limits: 准确 client 源码99356800e90aa0e7b604f652d714ef0f33422b47 使用缓存 CPython3.14.3、PostgreSQL17.1 和 pure-Python libpq，原报告为3.14.8/18.4。checkout 从已安装发行元数据读取3.3.9，不代表验证了发行版3.3.9。Connection 与上下文管理器 wrapper 身份依赖额外 API 观察，不能从 Task 父子关系推断共享资源，也没有捕获隐藏的 AsyncTransaction 对象身份。提交辅助函数为此独立 harness 增加。报告已说明事务栈清理根因，新增证据是历史 caller 与跨阶段资源状态。保留 b14、b15 各一次取消前的观察器失败；成功场景仅一次，未测嵌套 savepoint、多服务器/实现/版本、修复或重放。 此归因组件把后续复用块放入独立 Task，原报告是在 main 内直接执行；不声称复现原生产任务结构。

cases.contribution: Recover actual Task creation callers and combine explicitly observed Connection identity across cancelled entry, reuse and rollback failure.
cases.contribution_zh: 恢复真实 Task 创建 caller，并结合额外观察的 Connection 身份，关联取消入口、复用和 rollback 失败。
